summary: @arv-bedrock/logger ships preinstall Bun-runtime dropper executing an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods the bun binary, and uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js at npm install time. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily-obfuscated @bun-cjs bundle (shuffled string-array rotator, mangled identifiers) and is not declared in package.json's files array (which lists only dist/**/*), yet ships in the tarball. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an opaque in-package payload bypasses Node-level review, and the behavior has no relationship to the advertised purpose of a NestJS request-tracing/Winston logging middleware. The payload's actions on the installer host cannot be inspected from Node-visible code, and it executes automatically on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
